chapter.verse: Tua ahihleh bang i gen lai ding hiam? Hehpihna tampi a phak nadingin mawhna sungah omzom lai ding i hi hiam?
I tuaci dek kei ding hi. Mawhna sunga si eite pen tua sungah bangci nuntak theih lai ding i hi hiam?
Khris Jesu' sungah a kibaptize khinsa eite pen i vekin ama' sihna sungah zong a kibaptize khin i hihlam thei lo na hi uh hiam?

Tua hi a, sihna sungah kibaptizena tungtawnin eite pen amah tawh a kiphum i hi a, tua pen Pa' vanglian minpha tawh misite' lakpan Khris a kithawhkiksak mah bangin eite zong nuntakna thak sungah i kalsuan theih nading ahi hi.
Tua hi a, eite pen ama' sihna lim la-in amah tawh pumkhat suak i hihleh ama' thawhkikna lim mah la-in amah tawh pumkhat i suak taktak ding hi.
Mawhna pumpi bangmahlo suakin mawhna' sila i hih nawnloh nadingin i mihing lui pen amah tawh kikhailumkhawm khin cih i thei hi.
A hang pen a si khin mi khat, mawhna pan a peng khinzo ahi hi.
Tu-in eite Khris tawh sikhawm khinzo i hihleh amah tawh nungtakhawm ding ci-in zong i um hi.
Misite lakpan a thokik Khris pen misite' lakpan thokik khinzo ahih nungsang amah sikik ngei nawnlo ding cih i thei hi; sihna in ama' tungah uktheihna thu nei nawnlo hi.
A hang pen amah a sih ciangin khatvei tawh a kicing dingin mawhna sungah a si hi a, amah a nuntak ciangin Pasian' sungah a nungta ahi hi.
Tua hi a, note zong mawhna lamah a si, Khris Jesu hangin Pasian lamah a nungta ci-in noleno na kingaihsut ding uh ahi hi.
Note, mawhna in cilesa lunggulhna a zuite hong suahsak loh nadingin a sithei na pumpi uh mawhna uksak kei un.

Na pumpi nate uh diklohna vanzat bangin mawhna mai-ah laakkha kei unla, sihna pan nuntakna hong kitunpih khinsate na hihna uh tawh noleno Pasian' kiangah kilaakin na pumpi nate uh dikna vanzat bangin Pasian' kiang ap un.
Note, thukhun nuai-a om hilo-in hehpihna nuai-a om na hih khit nungsangun mawhna in no' tungah uktheihna thu nei lo ding hi.
Tua ahihleh bangci dan hiding hiam? Eite thukhun nuai-a om hilo-in hehpihna nuai-a om i hih manin mawhna a bawl dingte i hi hiam? I hi peuhmah kei hi.

Mi khatpeuh' kiangah noleno sila thumangte bangin na kipiak uhleh tua a thu na man uh mipa' sila na hi uh a, tua pen sihna lam hong manawhpih mawhna zong hithei, dikna lam hong manawhpih thumanna zong hithei, cih thei lo na hi uh hiam?
Ahi zongin Pasian' hehpihna i phat nading thu ah note hun khat lai-in mawhna sila hinapi tu-in note' tunga hong ki-apsawn hilhcianna etteh lim pen lungsim sungtawng pan mangin na zui uh a,
mawhna pan hong kikhahkhia-in diktatna sila na suak khinta uh hi.

Cilesa thanemna nei na hih manun nautang kam tawh hong hopih ka hi hi. A hang pen hun khat lai-in na pumpi nate uh thukhun pampaihna a khangsak ahi thanghuai gamtatna leh thukhun pampaihna' khutnuai ah sila dingin na piak mah bangun tu-in zong na pumpi nate uh diktatna hong tunpih ding ahi sianthona' khutnuai ah sila dingin pia un.
A hang pen note mawhna sila na hih lai-un diktatna vai-ah na peng uh hi.
Tu huna na zumpih uh, tua hun lai-a thute panin gahleteh bang teng ngah na hi uh hiam? Banghanghiam cihleh tuate' lamtawp pen sihna ahi hi.
Ahih hangin mawhna pan hong kikhahkhia khinin Pasian' sila suak khinta na hih manun na ngah uh gahletehte in sianthona hong tunpih ding a, tua ii lamtawp pen tawntung nuntakna ahi hi.
A hang pen mawhna a thamante sihna hi a, Pasian' hehpihna gah ahihleh i Topa Khris Jesu' sungah tawntung nuntakna ahi hi.
